Dear {!Get_Lead_Record.Name},

Warm Greetings from Panchshil Realty,


Thank you for reaching out to us. Since our office hours have concluded, our team will connect with you you at the earliest on the next working day. Meanwhile, please feel free to browse through our website {!$Label.EYI_PanchshilWebsite} or engage with our virtual assistant for instant information and guidance {!$Label.EYI_Chatbot_Link}.


At Panchshil, we deeply value your trust and look forward to being of any assistance you may need in the future. 


 Best regards, 

 Team Panchshil - +91 8970007700
